objective: Match groomed fresh snow across glide, edge support and release, stoppage/restart, 50 C wet durability, winter bonding, recovery and total cost
controls: same-batch natural groomed snow measured at recorded snow temperature and density

stages.purpose: Disprove prescribed force and kinematics with matched force/displacement boundaries
measure: force displacement and lateral motion simultaneously
unloading energy, permanent set and recovery time
rate dependence using measured ski load pulse durations
stages.note: Exploratory repetitions and independent lots must be assigned before testing; a scaled model does not validate a 500 um grain.

stages.purpose: True-size 3D random grains, fixed pressure vs fixed depth, including dense packing
measure: normal support and bed thickness loss
glide friction and vibration spectrum against snow
50 C exposure and repeated mechanical loading for 4-5 h operating interval
rain and silt plus functional restoration within 60 min closure
typhoon material retention, contamination and replacement fraction
winter snow interlock, drain path, freezing blockage and basal shear
wear fragments, extractables and exposure endpoints for finished material
process throughput, reject yield, repair and qualified recovery cost

acceptance: Numerical equivalence bounds must be based on independent snow reference and agreed before data review. Physical safety and performance gates are joint requirements. Do not score simulation cells as trials or treat repetitions from one batch as independent reliability trials.
critical_refutations: Progressive core may switch before contacts separate due to dimensional scatter
Dense packing q=1.5 remains caged within travel in the 2D model
Core interferes with contraction or blocks drainage
Gradual stiffening in a real structure may add hysteresis and destroy sharp edge release
manufacturing: No procurement, supplier contact, physical manufacturing or physical test was performed.
